coverage_override.reason: The summon trigger, its control-dependent activation suppression, the sent-to-GY Hallo summon trigger, and shared each-effect HOPT are four audit units.

effects.printed_clause: If Normal or Special Summoned: Special Summon a Level 3 or lower Zombie or Fiend from either GY to your field.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal/Special trigger clones select a legal Level 3-or-lower Zombie or Fiend from either GY under Necrovalley and Special Summon it to the controller's field.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summons a filtered Zombie from either GY to the controller's field.
Uses summon-success event structure and summon legality checks.

effects.printed_clause: The summoned monster cannot activate its effects while you control it.
effects.lua_implementation: The successfully summoned monster receives EFFECT_CANNOT_TRIGGER conditioned on still being controlled by the summoning player, with standard state-change reset.

official_references.matched_structure: Applies a restriction to a monster Special Summoned by the resolving effect.
Uses a conditional effect restriction with standard reset semantics.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 Hallo monster from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger searches the generated standalone-Hallo Monster name pool from the hand. The pool is rebuilt from official Omega and local names and contains official Hallo, the Spirit of Tricks plus both local Hallo monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: Provides the official Omega identity of the previously omitted official Hallo monster.
Uses a delayed sent-to-GY trigger with filtered follow-up processing.

effects.issue: Fixed: the Hallo pool is now generated from current names and includes official Hallo, the Spirit of Tricks.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Ween, Guidance to Treats once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The summon trigger clones share id; the sent-to-GY trigger uses id+100.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses distinct id-derived hard count keys on separate triggers.
